channel.title: The Grant Desk - Writers, US, next 90 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Writers, US, next 90 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 03 Aug 2026 (03 Aug to 09 Aug 2026).

  • Cullman Center Fellowships 2027-28 (New York Public Library)
    Dorothy and Lewis B. Cullman Center for Scholars and Writers, New York Public Library · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · USD 90,000 stipend, plus an office at the library, full access to collections, and a September-May term. No application fee.
